attributeExclusions.reason: Fang and Claw affects pets only; does not grant player precision/ferocity, including Beastmode.
Mechanical Genius affects mech inheritance, not player attributes. Separate mech attribute model required.
Electric Discharge critical damage is scoped to its own triggered lightning, not a global player attribute.
Precise Strike only guarantees Opening Strike critical hits, not all player attacks.
Jade Cannons critical chance belongs to the mech, not the player.
Burst Precision guarantees burst skills and grants a timed global buff; the buff conversion eligibility needs explicit verification before player ferocity is calculated.
